description: MBA programme related knowledge for MERI Admission Voice Agent.

questions: Can you tell me about the MBA programme?
faqs.answer: The MBA at MERI is a two-year full-time programme affiliated with Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU) and approved by AICTE. It focuses on management education through classroom learning, case studies, live projects, industry interaction, and experiential learning.

questions: What is the duration of MBA?
How much time does MBA take?
faqs.answer: The MBA programme is a two-year full-time programme.
The MBA programme is approved by AICTE and affiliated with Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU).

questions: What specializations are available in MBA?
Which MBA specializations do you offer?
faqs.answer: MBA specializations include Marketing, Finance, Human Resource Management, Business Analytics, International Business, and Information Technology.

questions: Which MBA specialization should I choose?
faqs.answer: The best specialization depends on your interests, strengths, and career goals. Our admissions counsellor can help you choose the most suitable specialization based on your aspirations.

The MBA programme includes management concepts, business communication, case studies, presentations, live projects, workshops, industry interaction, and experiential learning to develop practical management skills.
Students who have completed graduation or are in their final year can connect with the admissions team to verify the latest MBA eligibility requirements.

questions: How can I get admission in MBA?
How do I apply for MBA?
faqs.answer: The admission process includes confirming eligibility, discussing the programme with the admissions team, completing counselling, submitting the required documents, and following the institute's admission procedure.

questions: How much is the MBA fee?
faqs.answer: The latest MBA fee structure is shared by the admissions counsellor. Please connect with the admissions team for the most up-to-date fee details.

questions: What is the MBA placement record?
faqs.answer: MERI provides placement support, industry exposure, and employability-focused learning. The latest placement statistics and recruiter information can be shared during counselling.

questions: Which documents are required for MBA admission?
faqs.answer: Generally required documents include graduation marksheets, final-year proof if applicable, entrance exam scorecard if available, ID proof, and passport-size photographs.

questions: Can I get the MBA brochure?
Can you WhatsApp the MBA brochure?
faqs.answer: Yes, the MBA brochure can be shared on your WhatsApp after confirming your WhatsApp number.
